preconditions.description: The number of cities `n` is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
Each of the `n` city lines contains exactly two elements: a coordinate (integer) and a type (character 'B', 'R', or 'P').

preconditions.expression: all(city_type in {'B', 'R', 'P'} for _, city_type in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
preconditions.description: Each city type is either 'B' (Byteland), 'R' (Berland), or 'P' (disputed).

preconditions.expression: all(x_i != x_j for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n) for x_i, _ in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:i+1]) for _, _ in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:j+1]))
preconditions.description: All city coordinates are distinct (guaranteed by input order).

preconditions.expression: all(int(x_i) <= int(x_j) for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n) for x_i, _ in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:i+1]) for x_j, _ in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:j+1]))
preconditions.description: Cities are given in strictly increasing order of coordinates.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimal total cable length.

postconditions.expression: all(city_type != 'R' for x_i, city_type in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])) or (lambda cities: any(city_type == 'B' or city_type == 'P' for x_i, city_type in cities))(cities) and (lambda cities: all(any(abs(x_i - x_j) == cable_length for x_j, _ in cities if x_j != x_i for cable_length in cable_lengths) for x_i, _ in cities))(cities) and (lambda cities: all(any(abs(x_i - x_j) == cable_length for x_j, _ in cities if x_j != x_i for cable_length in cable_lengths) for x_i, _ in cities))(cities)
postconditions.description: For the subset of cities excluding Berland ('R'), the graph formed by cables (with lengths in `cable_lengths`) is connected. Here, `cities` is the list of cities with type 'B' or 'P', and `cable_lengths` is the multiset of cable lengths derived from the output.

postconditions.expression: all(city_type != 'B' for x_i, city_type in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])) or (lambda cities: any(city_type == 'R' or city_type == 'P' for x_i, city_type in cities))(cities) and (lambda cities: all(any(abs(x_i - x_j) == cable_length for x_j, _ in cities if x_j != x_i for cable_length in cable_lengths) for x_i, _ in cities))(cities) and (lambda cities: all(any(abs(x_i - x_j) == cable_length for x_j, _ in cities if x_j != x_i for cable_length in cable_lengths) for x_i, _ in cities))(cities)
postconditions.description: For the subset of cities excluding Byteland ('B'), the graph formed by cables (with lengths in `cable_lengths`) is connected. Here, `cities` is the list of cities with type 'R' or 'P', and `cable_lengths` is the multiset of cable lengths derived from the output.

The output is the minimal possible total cable length satisfying Q2 and Q3. Here, `min_possible_total_length` is the smallest sum of cable lengths that connects both subsets (Byteland+disputed and Berland+disputed) as required.
